warrants.quote: On December 24, 2019, we sold and issued 3,288,390 shares of non-voting Class A-2 convertible preferred stock and accompanying warrants to purchase an aggregate of 3,288,390 shares of common stock.

On December 4, 2020, we sold and issued (i) 2,434,152 shares of common stock (ii) 272,970 shares of non-voting Class A-3 convertible preferred stock and (iii) accompanying warrants to purchase an aggregate of 2,030,341 shares of common stock.
